verified_facts: composite DTM 1m covers about 99 percent of England
DTM removes surface objects to model bare terrain
composite uses time-stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
newest best-resolution survey is used where repeats exist
resampled data uses bilinear interpolation before merge
metadata index catalogues identify the contributing survey by location
composite 1m is aligned to OS National Grid in EPSG 27700
composite elevations are referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
individual source surveys have vertical accuracy plus or minus 15cm RMSE
time-stamped data uses survey-period-specific transformation and metadata should identify the geoid model
quality_effect: Requires survey lineage, epoch, datum and resampling provenance before any EA elevation sample can be promoted to parcel-level height evidence.
